name: Phileas's Hoard · Hermes
purpose: Absorbed by Hermes's Hoard. Compatibility identity only; no standalone server. A local shipment and trip tracker: reads shipping mail from the inbox configured in Faustus (shops, Amazon, carriers), turns it into shipments, follows each one with its carrier (UPS, Correos, DHL, 17TRACK for the rest) and estimates the arrival day from the carrier's date, the shop's date and promise and your own past parcels, with notifications by Windows toast, the family bus, ntfy, Telegram or email. It also reads travel bookings from the same mail (flights, trains, buses, ferries, car rental, stays), groups them into trips, reminds about online check-in, checks identity-document expiry through Kafka, shares trip expenses with balances and passes a person's share to Ledger, and exports trips to the calendar.
notes: Native compatibility identity owned by Hermes's Hoard. Data, tokens and all runtime files belong to the merged application. No retired repository is required. Start the owner explicitly and enable its module.
